rationale: The bid-ask spread of ~156 bps creates an immediate structural disadvantage that is difficult to overcome intraday, especially with an ATR of only $0.065 on 5-minute bars — the spread alone exceeds several ATR multiples. Price has dropped sharply from the open (~$64.91 to ~$62.23) with strong momentum candles still printing lower, making both a mean-reversion long and a continuation short risky without a clear stabilization pattern or defined support level. Given the wide spread, thin liquidity relative to the move, and already committed buying power in two working orders, the risk/reward does not justify adding exposure here.
